subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should this PR make subagent completion announce delivery turns always tool-free and reconcile interrupted announce runs to non-running "killed" state using persisted announceLastRun?
rationale: The code and proof look sound, but the PR canonizes both a security/tool boundary and a persisted session lifecycle state that should be owned intentionally.

options.title: Accept canonical announce recovery
options.body: Merge after routine branch freshness checks, treating announce delivery as a tool-free internal turn and killed/non-running as the canonical aborted-announce reconciliation state.

options.title: Adjust recovery state first
options.body: Keep the tool-free invariant but require a different non-running status or marker if killed is not the desired lifecycle representation.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery model
options.body: Hold the PR if announce recovery should be designed together with a larger session lifecycle refactor rather than fixed narrowly here.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical announce recovery
recommendation.body: Merge after routine branch freshness checks, treating announce delivery as a tool-free internal turn and killed/non-running as the canonical aborted-announce reconciliation state.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh Lehman has the strongest combined history across restart lifecycle seams, Codex internal-turn behavior, and announce delivery threading adjacent to the PR.
